title: No first-class way to dispatch a registered orchestrator agent (by brofile) with recursion enabled
wanted_capability: A single dispatch call that launches a registered agent/brofile AND enables allow_recursion, so a recursion-needing orchestrator bro (e.g. the gap-processing orchestrator that fans out to per-cluster validator sub-bros) can be launched by brofile name. Today bro_agent_dispatch resolves the brofile/filters but hardcodes allow_recursion=false (src/tools/agents.rs:906), while bro_exec carries allow_recursion but targets a named live bro or provider+inline-lens — brofile-template-by-name resolution via bro_exec is unverified. So launching a recursion-enabled orchestrator from a thin brofile has no clean path.
missing_primitive: allow_recursion param on bro_agent_dispatch, or documented/verified brofile-name targeting on bro_exec
fallback_used: Documented launch via bro_exec with allow_recursion=true and flagged brofile-by-name targeting as a FIRST-RUN VERIFY item in prompts/gap-processing.md
resolution_note: Two halves. (1) The "unverified" half was already first-class in code: resolve_exec_target falls through the live-team selector to standalone brofile-by-name resolution (src/tools/dispatch.rs), and bro_exec plumbs allow_recursion — now pinned by resolve_exec_target_standalone_brofile_fallback. (2) The real hole — bro_agent_dispatch hardcoding allow_recursion=false — is fixed manifest-declared (operator-selected): AgentManifest gains allow_recursion (default false, elided when false, back-compat with installed agents); bro_agent_dispatch passes it through. The orchestrator role is catalog data reviewed at install; deliberately NO per-call override on bro_agent_dispatch (ad-hoc recursive dispatch is bro_exec's allow_recursion). Docs: agent-system.md manifest table, bro_agent_dispatch tool stanza, prompts/gap-processing.md workaround note retired.
